prompt: Challenge C061-CH1: Our cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil goes rancid within 4 months on shelf, but competitors manage 9–12 months; we lose about 15% of each batch

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil composition has been characterized using gas chromatography and HPLC methods to profile fatty acids and tocopherols, which are key determinants of oxidative stability.","sources":[{"id":"R0403","field":"keywords","quote":"хладно пресована уља, профил масних киселина, триацилглицероли, GC-MS"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-04877","field":"keywords","quote":"pumpkin seed oil, roasting, HPLC-MS, TAG, tocopherols"}]},{"text":"Tocopherol content and composition in seed oils correlates with oxidative stability as measured by induction period testing, and roasting conditions can affect tocopherol retention and free fatty acid formation.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-04871","field":"abstract","quote":"Tocopherol analysis by HPLC-FLD showed α-tocopherol dominating rosehip oil"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-04877","field":"abstract","quote":"Free fatty acid content increased from 0.18% (unroasted) to 0.49% (160 °C)"}]},{"text":"Oxidative stability testing and analysis of lipid peroxide formation pathways in seed oils has been conducted using Rancimat induction period methods and HPLC-MS detection of oxidized triacylglycerol species.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-04871","field":"abstract","quote":"Rancimat induction periods were 2.4–3.8 h for rosehip oil and 4.1–5.9 h"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-04877","field":"abstract","quote":"with a corresponding increase in partially oxidised TAG species detected above the MRM threshold"}]}],"fit":"strong","fitReason":"The researcher has directly studied cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil oxidative stability, tocopherol profiling, and triacylglycerol composition using analytical methods [SYN-PUB-04877], and has experience characterizing lipid oxidation pathways in similar seed oils [SYN-PUB-04871], making this expertise highly relevant to identifying the company's oxidation pathway and peroxide formation mechanism."}
